summary: This EOB is for a chemotherapy infusion at Bayview Infusion Center on June 10, 2026. It shows a $350 coinsurance charge, but an automatic check found a problem: your out-of-pocket spending for the year would total $6,650.00, which is over your plan's $6,500.00 out-of-pocket maximum. Amounts above that maximum are the plan's responsibility, not yours. This looks like a plan processing error, not something you did wrong. Remember: an EOB is not a bill — do not pay anything based on this document.

lines.explanation: This line is for your chemotherapy infusion (first hour). The plan approved $1,750 of the $3,900 charge and paid $1,400. The $2,150 difference is written off by your provider under CO-45 (the discount your provider agreed to) — 'The difference is written off by the provider. Members do not owe CO-45 amounts for in-network care.' The $350 shown in your column is labeled PR-2 (coinsurance, your percentage share of the approved price). But the automatic math check found an error: your running out-of-pocket total ($6,650.00, including $6,300.00 already used this year) exceeds the plan's $6,500.00 out-of-pocket maximum. Amounts above the maximum are the plan's responsibility, not yours. So at least part of this $350 should not be your responsibility, and the claim likely needs to be reprocessed.

citations.quote: The difference is written off by the provider. Members do not owe CO-45 amounts for in-network care.
PR-2 means this amount is coinsurance, your percentage share of the allowed amount after the deductible is met.

math_findings.detail: Your running out-of-pocket total ($6,650.00, including $6,300.00 already used this year) exceeds the plan's $6,500.00 out-of-pocket maximum. Amounts above the maximum are the plan's responsibility, not yours.

actions: Do not pay any provider bill for this claim until the out-of-pocket maximum error is resolved.

Call Sunrise Health member services (number on your insurance card) and tell them claim CLM-2026-88790 charged coinsurance that pushes your yearly out-of-pocket total past the $6,500 maximum. Ask them to reprocess the claim.
Ask the plan to send you a corrected EOB showing the fixed amounts once the claim is reprocessed.
If a bill arrives from Bayview Infusion Center for $350, compare it to the corrected EOB before paying anything, and dispute any amount above what the corrected EOB says you owe.
escalate_reason: The code-verified math check found an ERROR: the coinsurance on this claim pushes the member's out-of-pocket total ($6,650.00) past the plan's $6,500.00 out-of-pocket maximum. Also, the retrieved passages do not include a plan document explaining the out-of-pocket maximum rule, so a human should confirm the exact corrected amount the member owes.
